game.title: Buffalo Bills at Las Vegas Raiders

lede: Buffalo Bills carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play), while Las Vegas Raiders owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#13 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Las Vegas Raiders +8.8 with a fair total of 49.9, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Buffalo Bills pass offence vs Las Vegas Raiders pass defence, which sits +0.275 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Buffalo Bills and Las Vegas Raiders have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
